title: Add cookie banner
body: If necessary. Probably because we're using Google Analytics
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: @michaltrzesimiech From a legal/privacy perspective, do we need a cookie banner?

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Yep, we need a cookie banner for GDPR reasons!

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: The cookie banner is just for Google Analytics, right? It doesn't need to be connected to anything else? I don't usually see sites displaying a cookie banner in order for users to log in.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
There are 3 different options for banners: info, opt-in, and opt-out. Went for info as it should be sufficient: "We cannot guarantee an informational approach will be sufficient for your website, but unless you have special cause to believe otherwise, it is extremely likely. If in doubt, seek legal advice from a professional."
https://cookieconsent.insites.com/documentation/compliance/

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
